description:
Drop-in starter that adds the BootUI developer console to a Spring Boot 4 WebFlux
        (reactive) application. Use this instead of bootui-spring-boot-starter when the host
        application is built on spring-boot-starter-webflux rather than spring-boot-starter-web, so
        BootUI does not pull in Tomcat/Spring MVC and force the app into servlet
        WebApplicationType.
